style: Refine every catalog object toward warm, softly lit cartoon art, consistent with the selected plant reference. Preserve identity, function and original palette family. Keep registered camera, dimensions, roots, sockets, ports, footprints and animation timing. No preferred horizontal light direction for rotatable world sprites; no directional ground shadows. Real 3D render output, editable Blender sources. The source 2D effects remain explicitly identified as 2D. Each object receives fresh independent editor/judge agents. Publish object-by-object to the same PR preview; integrate approved sprites into Godot after catalog review checks.

source.scene: Inspect the named asset collection; do not use an unrelated active scene

preserve: Every logical frame/root/sourceScale and per-clip/direction override
Original footprint, height/proportions, sockets, ports, rigs and projection
Every registered clip, facing, frame count and fps/loop behavior
Lighting without preferred horizontal direction for rotatable world objects; no directional ground cast shadow
Actual independent geometry views and native animation; no raster card or per-view image fitting/recolor
judgeMeasuredRequirements: Preserve native editable 3D stool, actual legs/support/cushion construction, authored height and proportions, footprint [1,1], ground root and seat socket [0,0,0.685].

Preserve registered camera projection, pixel aspect, world scale, logical frame [192,352], root [96,248], sourceScale 2 and 384x704 native delivered frame; no per-view fit, recoloring, raster card, or target-image registration substitution.
Deliver N/E/S/W independent native static facings, one frame each, 12 fps metadata and non-looping/static behavior; required four-view and repeated previews use the same capture.
Soft horizontally neutral world lighting across all directions; no directional ground cast shadow or added backing plane.

qualityCriteria.desiredVisibleOutcome: Seat reads as a padded rounded-square blue cushion with broad continuous surface variation and gently softened edge transitions; preserve seat size, native construction and usable attachment height. Legs and crossbar remain recognizable structural pieces.
failureExamples: Large perfectly uniform flat top with hard stepped rim bands
Over-inflated seat that changes the native footprint, height or contact
Blobby legs or merged supports that obscure stool construction

qualityCriteria.desiredVisibleOutcome: Retain a saturated blue cushion and warm honey wood legs/supports, with color variation that feels softly lit and friendly. Wood remains bright enough to read down to the feet; cushion blue remains distinct from wood.
failureExamples: Electric cyan flat panel separated by harsh royal-blue strips
Gray/brown muddy supports or palette change away from blue-and-honey-wood identity

qualityCriteria.desiredVisibleOutcome: Broad low-contrast highlights and gentle occlusion describe the cushion, legs and support joints. Keep horizontal symmetry; each facing belongs to one scene and lighting scheme.
failureExamples: Blown white/glassy spots or hard highlight stripes
Crushed dark joints, underside or feet

qualityCriteria.desiredVisibleOutcome: Cushion and wood feel softly tactile with restrained roughness and optional subtle coherent grain or fabric variation. Prioritize clean large forms and readable edges over target microtexture.
failureExamples: Noisy speckles or strong procedural bands visible at logical size
Abrupt normal seams or coplanar flicker

qualityCriteria.desiredVisibleOutcome: All four static facings remain clean and legible at 192x352 logical frame size as well as native enlargement. No material dead spots: opaque black patches, broken corners, clipped geometry, merged supports, exposed ends, seams or unwanted fringe. Clean transparency on light, neutral and dark backgrounds.
failureExamples: Dark gap incorrectly filled by opaque background
Lost wood leg or support at use size

delivery.scope: Refine this object only. Root coordinator promotes approved atlases, sources and metadata to production, publishes the PR preview, and finally updates Godot.
delivery.notes: Write source/round-NN.blend or the actual native 2D source as appropriate; full native captures, original-layout atlases, previews, validation and delivery.json. Do not label 2D artwork as a Blender model.
